note: Alberta Parks recreation area in the Clearwater River valley, 48 km southwest of Caroline on Hwy 591, with a cook shelter. Self-maintained by the Friends of the Eastern Slopes Association; no toilet paper or hand sanitizer supplied, and garbage must be packed out. Used by hikers and horseback riders, but there are no equestrian facilities. OHV riding and staging are permitted in the recreation area, with OHVs kept to established roads; the Forestry Trunk Road OHV corridor is nearby. --Claude
